goal: Collapse the three scheduler per-row outbox insert loops (WeeklySummaryScheduler, MonthlyImpactScheduler, RankingTrackingScheduler) each into one set-based INSERT…SELECT…ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING that merges the candidate SELECT with the enqueue.
non_goals: Do NOT change the time-gate windows, feature-flag gates, mock-mode gate, or subscription-status predicates of any scheduler.
Do NOT touch OnboardingDripScheduler or AutonomyGovernorScheduler (out of ticket scope).
Do NOT change what the consuming workers (WeeklySummaryWorker, SendMonthlyImpactWorker, RankingTrackingWorker) do with the payload.
Do NOT introduce sql.begin()/multi-statement transactions — each scheduler's only state write is the single job_outbox INSERT, which is already atomic.
Do NOT preserve ranking's separate candidates_checked log field (merge removes the standalone candidate count; only queued is logged, consistent with the other two).
user_visible_behavior: No externally observable behavior change: the same eligible businesses get the same job_outbox rows enqueued with the same payload shape ({business_id, week_start_date|month_start_date|(google_place_id,run_date), correlation_id}).

Dedup for weekly_summary and send_monthly_impact is now enforced by a partial unique index (migration 079) plus ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, closing the concurrent-scheduler / restart race that WHERE NOT EXISTS alone could not.
Each cycle now issues ONE set-based INSERT per scheduler instead of 1 candidate SELECT + N per-row inserts.
invariants: Outbox invariant #2: state change + enqueue in one transaction — satisfied trivially; the single INSERT is the only write and is atomic.

Idempotency: a business already enqueued (in-flight) or already recorded complete for the same period must not be re-enqueued. Enforced by candidate-level NOT EXISTS (in-flight pre-filter) + partial unique index + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
Tenant scoping: schedulers intentionally scan tenant rows globally (background-global-scan) before enqueueing scoped work — must remain allowlisted in tenant-scope-allowlist.ts.
Payload shape and field types are byte-compatible with the current per-row payloads (business_id/google_place_id as JSON strings, dates as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings, correlation_id as a UUID string).

Weekly/monthly partial unique index predicate is status IN ('pending','dispatching','dispatched') — EXACTLY mirrors the current in-flight WHERE NOT EXISTS so behavior is preserved (a 'completed'-but-not-sent row must NOT block re-enqueue; the worker legitimately markOutboxCompleted's without setting sent_at in 3 skip cases: archived, subscription-not-allowed, bounced email). Ranking keeps its existing status <> 'failed' index (no sent_at guard; the outbox completion IS its done-record).
edge_cases: gen_random_uuid() (UUIDv4) replaces app-generated UUIDv7 for job_outbox.id and payload.correlation_id in the set-based path — deliberate, documented deviation. Justification: prod Postgres has no uuidv7() function; a set-based INSERT…SELECT cannot call the JS UUIDv7 generator per row; job_outbox.id has NO ordering contract (002 DROPPED its default; the INSERT supplies id explicitly; OutboxPoller orders by available_at, not id); rows are 7-day-pruned; correlation_id is an opaque trace string. Requires code comment + lab note.
Empty candidate set: INSERT…SELECT inserts 0 rows and logs nothing (queued=0) — no error.

A 'completed'-but-not-sent weekly/monthly outbox row must NOT block re-enqueue (worker markOutboxCompleted's without sent_at on archived/subscription/bounced skips) — hence the in-flight-only index predicate, preserving current behavior; a 'failed' row is likewise not blocked (retry preserved).

Migration 079 preflight: mirror migration 015 — collapse any pre-existing in-flight duplicates (keep oldest per (aggregate_id, period), mark rest 'failed') BEFORE each CREATE UNIQUE INDEX, so the index build cannot fail on historical duplicates; staging-first apply as a second safety net.
Concurrent scheduler processes / restart both passing the NOT EXISTS pre-filter: the second INSERT's conflicting rows are absorbed by ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (no 23505 surfaced).
Ranking: the pre-merge `if (candidates.length === 0) return` micro-guard is removed; runDate is computed unconditionally (cheap) and a 0-row INSERT is a no-op.
existing_patterns_to_follow: RankingTrackingScheduler.ts current INSERT…VALUES…ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (target-less) — the ON CONFLICT idiom for outbox dedup.

jsonb_build_object(...) in SQL for set-based payload construction (replaces the JS-side jsonb() helper, which cannot run per-row inside INSERT…SELECT).

tests_to_add: Per scheduler: the set-based INSERT enqueues exactly the eligible businesses (parity with the old loop) given a candidate fixture.
Dedup: a business with an in-flight (pending/dispatching/dispatched) outbox row for the same period is NOT re-enqueued.
Dedup: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING absorbs a duplicate insert without surfacing 23505 (unique-index conflict path).
sent_at / period-marker guard still excludes already-recorded businesses (weekly_summaries / monthly_impact_emails).
Payload shape assertion: business_id, period date, and correlation_id are present and correctly typed; correlation_id values are distinct per row.
queued count reflects inserted.count (rows actually inserted, not candidates scanned).
